package i18n

import (
	"os"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestSyntheticLocaleCatalogProfile(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	profile := os.Getenv("ZNS_TEST_LOCALE_PROFILE")
	require.Contains(t, []string{"primary-gap", "fallback-gap", "missing-all"}, profile)
	require.Equal(t, []Locale{English, Russian}, SupportedLocales())
	for _, raw := range []string{"be", "by", "uk", "ua", "pl"} {
		t.Run(raw, func(t *testing.T) {
			t.Parallel()
			require.False(t, IsSupported(raw))
			text, err := Translate(raw, LanguageChoose, nil)
			if profile == "missing-all" {
				require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrUnknownMessage)
				require.Empty(t, text)
				return
			}
			require.NoError(t, err)
			expected := "Выберите язык."
			if raw == "pl" || profile == "fallback-gap" {
				expected = "Choose your language."
			}
			require.Equal(t, expected, text)
		})
	}
	for _, test := range []struct {
		locale Locale
		text   string
	}{
		{English, "Current language: en."},
		{Russian, "Текущий язык: ru."},
	} {
		text, err := Translate(string(test.locale), LanguageCurrent, map[string]string{"language": string(test.locale)})
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, test.text, text)
	}
}
